LocalGo

Ordering and delivery, from the mobile interface to deployment.

What I built

I co-founded LocalGo and built ordering, dispatch, and tracking flows with React Native, TypeScript, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.

I test APIs with pytest and Postman, user flows with Playwright, and API load with JMeter. Prometheus and Grafana make performance results visible. Deployment work includes Docker, Expo/EAS, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, and Helm.

Goer AI

I integrated an assistant using OpenAI tool calling for menu search and product questions. The food-discovery agent uses CrewAI, OpenAI, and Pydantic across 138 products, with prices enforced in Python.

Langfuse traces agent decisions and tool calls. DeepEval runs 100 scenarios in CI to check tool selection, relevance, and factual grounding.
